ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Manage and follow up on a portfolio of litigation matters under Mexican procedural law.

- Handle labor law matters and disputes.

- Review, draft, and advise on contractual matters.

- Advise on financial user claims.

- Respond to and manage requirements from governmental authorities.

- Coordinate external law firms, setting strategy, monitoring progress, and ensuring quality.

- Work with internal stakeholders and negotiate with external parties.

- Keep case information and documentation organized and up to date.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Experience and knowledge

- Law degree, with experience in the banking or financial sector.

- Knowledge of Mexican procedural law and experience managing litigation portfolios.

- Knowledge and experience in labor law and labor matters.

- Knowledge and experience in contractual law.

- Knowledge and experience advising on financial user claims.

- Experience addressing governmental requirements.

Skills

- Strong communication and negotiation skills with internal and external stakeholders.

- Ability to think within the scope of the law while finding creative solutions to problems.

- Ability to coordinate external lawyers and internal stakeholders.

- Organized approach to managing information and documentation.

WORK SETUP

Location

Mexico City

Work model

[Hybrid / On-Site]

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

- 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

- Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here https://script.google.com/a/macros/nubank.com.br/s/AKfycbwvrewE58oGSbRWIVv8CyCWN68GLxpPVsfYYXv-ZHg94QFsTJmi82rF1x0yt-OTs2W0DQ/exec
